Why drivers overpay

Free apps log your miles. The money leaks out after that.

Four places gig drivers lose money at tax time, and what Gig Tax Buddy does about each one.

01 / 04

Untracked tips

Rideshare and delivery drivers can now deduct qualified tips from income tax. Only if you record them.

Up to $25,000 · 2025-2028
02 / 04

App fees on the 1099-K

The 1099-K shows the gross amount before fees. Skip the fee deduction and you pay tax on money you never got.

Gross, before fees
03 / 04

Underpayment penalties

The IRS expects tax during the year. With a day job, one W-4 change can cover your gig tax.

Form W-4, Step 4(c)
04 / 04

The 15.3% surprise

Self-employment tax hits most of your profit on top of income tax. Nobody withholds it for you.

FAQ

Straight answers.

Does it track miles automatically?

No. Keep a free GPS app like Stride for miles, or use your odometer, and type the weekly total here. In return you get no battery drain, no location tracking, and an odometer-based log with optional photos.

How accurate is the tax estimate?

It uses the IRS 2026 tax brackets and standard deduction, self-employment tax with the $184,500 Social Security wage base, the 20% qualified business income deduction, the tips deduction and the 72.5¢ mileage rate. It doesn't include credits like the EITC or child tax credit, detailed state rules, or the 0.9% additional Medicare tax. It's an estimate, not tax advice.

Can I really skip quarterly payments?

If you have a job with a paycheck, the IRS lets you cover other income by having more tax withheld: give your employer a new Form W-4. Withholding counts as paid evenly through the year, so it can catch up earlier quarters too. Sources: Form 1040-ES, Form 2210 instructions.

Do my tips qualify for no tax on tips?

Rideshare drivers (occupation 802) and goods delivery workers (804) are on the Treasury's list of tipped occupations. Self-employed workers can deduct qualified tips, up to $25,000 a year from 2025 through 2028, reduced above $150,000 of income ($300,000 joint) and capped at your net business income. It lowers income tax, not self-employment tax.

Do I need the App Store or Google Play?

No. It's a web app. Open it on your phone and add it to your home screen: on iPhone tap Share, then Add to Home Screen; on Android tap the menu, then Install app. It gets its own icon and works offline.

Is my data private?

Yes. There's no account and no server storing your data. Everything, including odometer photos, stays on your phone. Pro includes a backup file you can keep anywhere.

How do I get Pro after paying?

Checkout is handled by Gumroad. Right after payment you get an unlock link and code by email. Open the link on your phone and Pro turns on.
